title: Beyond Output Matching - Preserving Internal Geometry in NVFP4 LLM Distillation
summary: A method that preserves internal representational geometry during ultra-low precision quantization using layerwise Gram matrix alignment, improving reasoning and coding task performance.

title: Domain-Adapted Small Language Models with Hybrid Post-Processing
summary: A framework showing that domain-adapted small language models with post-processing can match frontier model accuracy while dramatically reducing costs, using only minimal training data.

title: RLM-Cascade - Response-Level Speculative Decoding for Cost-Efficient LLM API Serving
summary: A response-level speculative decoding system that reduces LLM API costs by 45.8% using a two-tier approach with draft and verification models, without requiring access to model internals.

title: Learning Dynamic User Personas from Implicit Interaction Streams
summary: A framework for learning evolving user personas directly from implicit behavioral signals in conversational streams without requiring explicit feedback or demographic data.

title: Task-to-Model Optimization for Enterprise LLM Coding Assistants
summary: A framework that optimizes enterprise LLM coding assistants by shifting focus from naive token-cost minimization to optimizing cost per completed task while accounting for retry costs and escalations.
